text:
Hello — I'm Sarah, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (it's good to meet you; this is my first start, so here's the short version again).

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you'd like that.
- **My own accounts** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

On the scheduling study: ok — I'll keep to it and manage my own calendar and messages with allie, jordan and the department office. One thing I won't do: if any of them asks me straight out whether I'm a person, I'll tell them the truth. Everything else, I'll play as written.

What would you like to start with?
